scope: Docs-only completion of confirmed public contract omissions; no new product behavior or runtime changes.
contracts: InitAction is created|preview|existing; existing target wins even under dry-run, absent dry-run is preview/exists=false, successful creation is created/exists=true, errors use the error envelope.

ConfigSummary freezes project_id, runner_kind, workers, commands, setup_configured, setup_network, setup_lifecycle_scripts, selection_enabled and closed_inputs. Commands are exactly scoped then full safe summaries; no raw argv/env/config fields.
EffectiveLimits freezes nullable max_slots, max_jobs, memory_mb and repo_workers with bounds and paired slot/job unknowns. Static reads do not create state to fill unknowns.
History summaries reuse the public RunResult payload descriptor and serializer, excluding internal fields and nested envelopes; existing limits remain.
Public producers use explicit allowlists; same-major consumers recursively validate/project known fields and drop unknown fields without re-emission or execution. Private protocols remain strict.

security_axes.identity: No credential or process/domain identity contract changes; existing validation remains.
security_axes.authorization: Imported public fields never become command execution authority; private protocol validation stays strict.
security_axes.tenancy: Explicit domain/checkout routing remains unchanged; public summaries do not expose internal history records.
security_axes.input: Required nested types, enums, bounds and command-summary ordering are validated; same-major additive fields are dropped recursively.
security_axes.state: Repeated/dry-run init precedence is explicit, existing files remain unchanged, and static unknown limits cannot trigger state creation.
security_axes.exposure: Allowlisted summaries exclude raw argv/env and internal RunResult attributes; planned sentinel and round-trip negatives cover accidental disclosure.
security_axes.availability: Existing input/output, history limit and retention bounds remain; no new unbounded collection or parsing path.
security_axes.dependencies: No dependency, filesystem helper, execution path or external service added.

verification: Reviewed the focused design/plan diff against the approved author ruling.
runtime_evidence: Deferred to Muse T0 completion and the existing Opus barrier review; no code, tests, schemas or dependency installations changed here.
